info.title: h3 serve
info.description:
MiniMax H3 text/image/reference to video with stereo audio over HTTP. The GPU engine is single-tenant: requests queue and run one at a time, and a request returns when its video is finished.

Video is `video/mp4` (H.264 + AAC) at 24 fps. Media fields are base64 file contents; a `data:` URL prefix is accepted.

post.description: Send JSON, or the prompt itself as a plain body. Without `image`, `last_image` or `width`/`height` the canvas follows `aspect` at `megapixels`; with a keyframe it follows the image's aspect ratio. Sizes snap to multiples of 32 and frame counts to the model's 17k+5 grid at 24 fps. Poll `GET /v1/status` for progress while this request is open.

value.prompt: A red fox trots through fresh snow at dawn, crunching footsteps.
A street musician plays violin in the rain.
<Picture 1> walks through the scene, speaking with the voice of <Audio 1>

text/plain.example: A red fox trots through snow

get.summary: What the engine is doing right now
get.description: Cheap enough to poll every few hundred milliseconds. `done`/`total` count denoising steps while `stage` is `sampling` and VAE chunks while it is `decoding`; other stages have `total` 0.

prompt.description: What to generate. Reference tags `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>` and `<Audio 1>` refer to the media in `ref_images`, `ref_videos` and `ref_audios`, numbered per type.

megapixels.description: Canvas area in units of 1024², used with `aspect` or a keyframe.

aspect.description: Aspect ratio when there is no keyframe.

steps.description: Sampling steps (server default, 20 unless started with `--steps`).

seed.description: Noise seed; random when omitted. The same seed gives ComfyUI's starting latent.

fit.description: How keyframes are fitted to the canvas.

ref_images.description: Reference images (base64). Cannot be combined with keyframes.

ref_videos.description: Reference videos (base64 MP4); their soundtrack becomes the matching `<Audio j>`.

ref_video_mute.description: Ignore the soundtracks of the reference videos.

ref_audios.description: Reference audio, e.g. a voice to speak with (base64).

ref_image_size.description: `max` keeps references at a 2048 px short edge: best identity fidelity, slower.

lora.description: LoRA file name from `GET /v1/info`; `"none"` disables the server's default LoRA.

upscale.description: Sample at the requested size, upscale the latent N times with the MiniMax H3 latent upscaler, and finish the remaining steps at that larger size, which is the size of the returned video (cheaper than sampling everything at N times the size). 0 or 1 turns it off. Needs the upscaler model (`upscaler` in `GET /v1/info` is null without it), otherwise the request fails.

upscale_split.description: With `upscale`: fraction of the steps sampled at the low resolution.

upscaler.description: The latent upscaler checkpoint, when installed (needed by `upscale`).

loras.description: LoRA files the server can load.
